negative_snippets:
I recently stayed at this hotel and would rate my experience 3 stars. The room itself was really nice – spacious, clean, and well-maintained. The bed was comfortable, and the overall ambiance of the room made my stay relaxing. In terms of room quality, the hotel definitely delivers.

However, the service was quite disappointing. Staff response was very slow, and it often felt like basic requests were being ignored or delayed. A good hotel experience is not just about having a great room, but also about feeling welcomed and well taken care of, and unfortunately, this aspect was lacking during my stay.

If you are someone who values comfort and just needs a nice room, this place could be a good option. But if you are looking for warm hospitality and prompt service, you might be left dissatisfied. Overall, great rooms but poor service balance out to an average experience for me.
